description: Frozen questions for comparing research models and retrieval quality.

cases.question: What books did Albert Camus write, in what year, and when did he receive the Nobel Prize and for what work?
What were the major milestones of Apollo 11, who were the astronauts, and what scientific work was done on the lunar surface?
How did the printing press change Europe between 1450 and 1600, and what evidence supports its impact on education, religion, and science?
What did Albert Einstein win the Nobel Prize for, and when?
What are the main works of William Shakespeare, and which are generally considered his major tragedies?
What is CRISPR-Cas9, and which scientists are most closely associated with its development?
Which single book did Albert Camus submit to win the Nobel Prize in Literature?
What evidence shows how printed scientific books changed the circulation of knowledge in Europe before 1600?
